data.name: Selestine
data.gender_notes: Selestine is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'selas' meaning 'moon' and 'tina' meaning 'star', Selestine is a name that signifies radiance and luminosity. In Christianity, the name is associated with Saint Selestine, a legendary Greek virgin and martyr who was said to have been brought to Rome during the persecution of Diocletian. The name Selestine carries the meaning “Moon Star” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Selestine usually hope their child will grow to embody moon star and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizing the divine light and guidance of the moon and stars.
data.etymology: Selestine belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon Star.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Selestine total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
